mechanics.executable_reminder: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, if this creature doesn't have the infamous status, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then give this creature the infamous status.

rule_text.name: 702.257a
rule_text.rule: Infamy is a triggered ability. “Infamy N” means “When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn’t infamous, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes infamous.”

rule_text.name: 702.257b
rule_text.rule: Infamous is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that the infamy ability and other spells and abilities can identify. Only permanents can be or become infamous. Once a permanent becomes infamous, it stays infamous until it leaves the battlefield. Infamous is neither an ability nor part of the permanent’s copiable values.

rule_text.name: 702.257c
rule_text.rule: If a creature has multiple instances of infamy, each triggers separately. The first such ability to resolve will cause the creature to become infamous, and subsequent abilities will have no effect. (See rule 603.4)
